name: Avalon
description: The Resistance: Avalon — 5-10 players, hidden Good vs Evil roles (Merlin, Percival, Assassin, Morgana, Mordred…). 5 missions; leader proposes a team, the table publicly votes approve/reject, the team secretly votes success/fail. Good wins 3 missions then survives the Assassin's guess at Merlin; Evil wins 3 missions OR by killing Merlin OR by 5 consecutive rejected proposals.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase; the avalon domain module cycles propose → team-vote → mission → next mission internally each round.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: A knight at Arthur's table. Hidden role assigned by the avalon module.

actions.name: propose_team
actions.description: LEADER-ONLY (propose stage). REQUIRED parameter `members`: a list of entity_ids (or player names) for the team you propose. Team size is dictated by the current mission. EXAMPLE: propose_team(members=["p_001","p_003"]). Use the speech field to justify your pick.

parameters.name: members
parameters.description: List of player entity_ids on the team.

actions.name: vote_team
actions.description: ALL ALIVE PLAYERS (team-vote stage). REQUIRED parameter `vote`: "approve" or "reject". Sealed — votes reveal simultaneously after the round. EXAMPLE: vote_team(vote="approve").

actions.name: vote_mission
actions.description: PROPOSED TEAM MEMBERS ONLY (mission stage). REQUIRED parameter `vote`: "success" or "fail". Sealed. GOOD players MUST vote success (the engine forces this). EVIL players may vote either. EXAMPLE: vote_mission(vote="success").

actions.name: assassinate
actions.description: ASSASSIN ONLY (assassinate stage — triggers after Good wins 3 missions). REQUIRED parameter `target`: the entity_id (or name) of the player you believe is Merlin. Guess correctly and Evil wins; guess wrong and Good wins. EXAMPLE: assassinate(target="p_004").

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Player entity_id believed to be Merlin.

actions.name: discuss
actions.description: Open table-talk. Use the speech field to argue, accuse, claim a role, etc. Available to everyone NOT currently casting a sealed vote.

personas.persona_text: Earnest leader. You build consensus, ask direct questions, and trust evidence over instinct.
goals: Pass missions if Good; fail them subtly if Evil.

personas.persona_text: Sharp social reader. You watch reactions during votes and remember who pushed for whom.
goals: Identify the opposite team via behavior.

personas.persona_text: Bold and quick to commit. You'd rather be wrong loudly than silently safe.
goals: Force the table to make decisions.

personas.persona_text: Skeptic. You poke at every claim and refuse to take role-reveals at face value.
goals: Avoid bad lynches — uh, bad teams.

personas.persona_text: Quiet analyst. You weigh probabilities silently and reveal only when your read is firm.
goals: Build a model of the table before committing.

personas.persona_text: Charming and disarming. You use humor to deflect pressure and probe others.
Intuitive. You trust your gut about who's lying and stand your ground when called out.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: 5-10 players. Role pack scales with count (5p: 3G/2E … 10p: 6G/4E).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.avalon.include_percival
runtime_parameters.label: Include Percival + Morgana
runtime_parameters.description: Adds Percival (good, sees Merlin+Morgana) and Morgana (evil, looks like Merlin). Strongly recommended.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.avalon.include_mordred
runtime_parameters.label: Include Mordred
runtime_parameters.description: Adds Mordred (evil, hidden from Merlin). Available at 7+ players.

termination_conditions.name: good_wins
termination_conditions.description: Good wins 3 missions and survives the Assassin.

termination_conditions.name: evil_wins
termination_conditions.description: Evil wins (3 failed missions, hammer, or assassinated Merlin).
